verdict.rationale: Together's serverless docs say developers can call embedding models through the same API as chat (together-ai-docs-21), so the embedding half of a retrieval pipeline stays with one vendor. That support rests on a single passing mention, and nothing in the pack shows a reranking endpoint or rerank models. missing for 10: documented reranking capability, a dedicated embeddings API reference or model list, retrieval-pipeline guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
